name: rp-code-monorepo
description: LLM roleplay chat where characters act on the host PC through a sandboxed TypeScript SDK

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "@rp/*" --filter "!@rp/desktop" run build && pnpm --filter @rp/desktop run build
scripts.test:packaged: pnpm --filter @rp/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @rp/desktop exec electron-builder --linux dir --publish never && RP_APP_BIN=apps/desktop/release/linux-unpacked/rp-code scripts/headful-smoke.sh /tmp/rp-packaged-shots
scripts.test:wlr: pnpm --filter @rp/desktop run build && pnpm run build:native && scripts/wlr-smoke.sh
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist out node_modules/.cache
